verdict.rationale: Cost visibility is a fair question for a paid video-generation model, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no Veo documentation of pre-run cost estimates or in-product spend tracking. The only cost-related items are community reports of burning $48 in GCP credit on 12 videos, which describe host-platform billing after the fact, not a Veo capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards
